title: Diagnostic ribbon spritepack + stepper overlays for transient failure flows
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact, production-ready spritepack and stepper overlay set intended for the Quickstart and Troubleshooting docs. Assets will illustrate transient error states (rate limits, request timeouts, retry backoff) as well as graceful fallbacks (smaller model, cached response). These assets will be used across: docs quickstart flows, in-console banners, and the onboarding email kit. Deliverables must support SVG and PNG export, motion-reduced variants, and localized microcopy slots.
acceptance_criteria: Spritepack contains 6 ribbon states (ok, throttled, queued, timed_out, retrying, degraded) exported as single SVG sprite and per-state PNG at 2x and 3x
Stepper overlays (3-step and 5-step) demonstrate retry backoff timelines with tappable 'Learn more' and 'Retry now' CTA placements for mobile/desktop
Microcopy variants approved by PM for succinct tone: developer-first, directive, and empathetic—English canonical set + placeholders for i18n
Color tokens conform to design system and pass WCAG 2.1 AA for text and icons; motion-reduced GIF/PNG for animations
Engineering sign-off on asset sizes and suggested implementation notes (use SVG sprite where possible; fallback to PNG for legacy clients)
Drive folder with high-res exports, source Figma file, and implementation spec link available in ticket attachments
tasks: Design initial sprite concepts & naming convention
Design stepper overlay composables for 3/5-step flows
Write microcopy variants and localization placeholders
Run accessibility contrast checks and update color tokens
Export sprites (SVG + PNG @2x/@3x) and produce motion-reduced versions
Prepare implementation handoff (CSS snippets, recommended DOM structure, filesize budget)
Gather engineering review and iterate on asset sizes/perf
Upload final assets to Drive and update docs references
